Card Q&A.a: No. You must fully activate this card's effect, then activate the [When Deleted] effect.
Card Q&A.q: I use this card's effect to delete one of my Digimon with a [When Deleted] effect. Can I activate the [When Deleted] effect before this card's "delete 1 of your opponent's level 4 or lower Digimon" effect?

Card Q&A.a: They activate at the same time, which means the turn player resolves their effect first.
Card Q&A.q: I use this card to delete one of my own Digimon, and an opponent's Digimon. If they both have [When Deleted] effects, which effect resolves first?

Effect: [Main] By deleting 1 of your Digimon, delete 1 of your opponent's level 4 or lower Digimon.
Inherited Effect: [Security] Delete 1 of your opponent's level 4 or lower Digimon.
